NanoKnow Benchmark Qrels
	

[Paper] [Code]
Pre-built relevance judgments (qrels) that partition SQuAD and Natural Questions (NQ) into supported and unsupported splits based on whether the answer appears in the nanochat pre-training corpus (karpathy/fineweb-edu-100b-shuffle).
These qrels are part of the NanoKnow project: github.com/castorini/NanoKnow
